entry.content:
This is your first post. Delete this text and write whatever you want here — Markdown works (headings, bold, code, links, images, lists).

To publish a new post:

  1. Copy this file.
  2. Rename it YYYY-MM-DD-a-short-title.md (the date in the filename controls sort order).
  3. Change the title and date in the front matter at the top.
  4. Write your post below the second ---.
  5. Push to GitHub — it appears on /blog.html automatically.
